kubejsapotheosisrecipesmatchthegeneratedscript: The loaded recipe manager matches the installed generated script: 4 edited Apothic shelves contain their staged component and keep their output, 46 removals are absent, 21 new ENTRELUMEN recipes exist with the right output.

spawneraugmentsmodifyrealspawnersandrunesaregone: A placed vanilla spawner is the Apothic spawner tile. The original fermented spider eye no longer changes it. The spawn count augment adds 2 and is consumed; with quartz in the offhand it reverts to the original count, consuming the augment and keeping the quartz. The solitude augment sets and its inverse clears ignore_players. Exactly 32 spawner_modifier recipes load, all apothic_spawners paths on ENTRELUMEN augments; rune recipes are absent.

atlaslibrarycapsbyrealeternawithoutduplication: Sixteen patina shelves give 60 Eterna (cap 24). Four Sharpness X books through the item handler add 1024 lumen; level 25 is refused; Sharpness XI costs exactly 1024; Looting IV, never deposited, costs 40. Breaking drops one library with its pool and placing it restores the same pool.

worldtieroverridesopenwhentheteamclosesacts: All five apotheosis:progression advancements carry only the pack criterion (tick for Haven, impossible otherwise) and the ENTRELUMEN description. Closing Act II through Entrelumen.advance made Apotheosis WorldTier.isUnlocked report Frontier (and Haven, not Ascent) after the companion's own tick. Closing Act III opened Ascent, Act VI Summit, and the Ark ending Pinnacle exactly once.

arcanerestorationkeepsapotheosisandmoddeddataatarealark: At a real Ark, a netherite sword with Sharpness VII, Curse of Binding, Apothic Scavenger II, Apotheosis sockets, durability bonus, boss origin and affix name and repair_cost 63 came back identical except repair_cost 0, for six books and 30 levels; a replay charged nothing.
arcanerestorationresetsforginghistoryandkeepseverythingelse: Isolated restoration case repeated in the full pack: exact components, five books and 25 levels, campaign unchanged, no replay charge.

arcanerestorationrejectswithoutpartialpayment: Isolated rejection case repeated in the full pack: book, insufficient books or levels, wrong hand, incomplete or ambiguous Ark, spectator and remote use reject without mutation; creative pays.
fullpack.limitation: Eight targeted cases, not all 84 registered tests. QA players are mock connections on the server. The tick warnings (up to 90 s behind) occurred while the disk was contended and are not a performance measurement; the run used max-tick-time 180000.
